questions.question: Which of the following are valid techniques to reduce hallucinations in LLMs? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Hallucinations can be reduced by grounding responses in trusted sources, providing citations, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to retrieve factual information, and fine-tuning models on high-quality domain-specific datasets. Increasing temperature generally increases randomness and may increase hallucinations.

questions.question: Which capability distinguishes Azure AI Search from basic search engines?
questions.explanation: Azure AI Search provides AI enrichment capabilities such as OCR, entity recognition, language detection, key phrase extraction, semantic search, and vector search. These capabilities go beyond traditional keyword-based search systems.

questions.question: Which of these is a common method for AI Alignment?

options.text: Limiting the AI's access to the internet
Adding more RAM to the computer

questions.explanation: AI alignment focuses on ensuring AI systems behave according to human values and intended objectives. Common alignment techniques include Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and Constitutional AI, which guide models toward safer and more helpful behavior.
